subject.title: feat(firecrawl): add keyless Firecrawl Search (Free) provider + richer firecrawl_search options

question: Should OpenClaw publish `firecrawl-free` as an official opt-in keyless web_search provider even though Firecrawl's current docs still state that `/v2/search` requires bearer-token authentication?
rationale: This changes a public provider/config surface and a privacy-sensitive hosted search route; code review can verify credential isolation, but cannot decide whether OpenClaw should own an undocumented no-auth search dependency.

options.title: Block Until Sponsored Contract
options.body: Require maintainer sponsorship and upstream/documented proof for keyless search before merging the provider surface.

options.title: Accept Opt-In Provider Risk
options.body: Merge the provider after maintainers explicitly accept the hosted no-auth search privacy and support boundary.

options.title: Split Keyed Tool Expansion
options.body: Drop `firecrawl-free` from this PR and keep only the credentialed `firecrawl_search` option parity work.

recommendation.title: Block Until Sponsored Contract
recommendation.body: Require maintainer sponsorship and upstream/documented proof for keyless search before merging the provider surface.

likelyOwner.reason: They owned the accepted scoped Firecrawl keyless path and left search credentialed in the prior maintainer decision trail.
